name: HYDRA-UMC-BRIDGE-ROS2
notes: Dependency-free safety coordinator with a ROS 2 interface plan, plus a real, lazily-imported rclpy transport for the 2 interfaces that have a real standard ROS 2 message type today (safe_stop_service via std_srvs/Trigger, state_topic via std_msgs/String) - inspect_service/job_action still need a custom .srv/.action definition this repository doesn't have yet. The optional rclpy runtime is intentionally not installed until it is tested against a real ROS 2 deployment. The safe-stop call uses call_async()+spin_until_future_complete() with a real bounded timeout on the response itself, not just on service availability. v0.0.7: the test suite's own unknown-phase reproduction (a raw string BridgeJob construction) was updated to match HYDRA-UMC-SDK's own real construction-time rejection (REV-008) - split into a real construction-rejection test plus a minimal double proving the coordinator's own defensive fallback still fails closed.
